question: What has been told to the addressed one concerning the group of the six-faced one and others?
premises: It concerns the group of the six-faced one.
inference: An account concerning the group of the six-faced one has been told to Kāmeśī.
uncertainties: The content of what was told is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: O Kāmeśī, what concerns the group of the six-faced one has been told to you.
